cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(DBcan C)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

set(TRANSPORT_CORE_INC   ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/core/inc)
set(TRANSPORT_PORT_INC   ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/transports/inc)

# Register map — generated by regc from register/src/regc/data/global_reg.yaml.
# Never committed; regenerated whenever the map, schema or protocol constants
# change, so the header can never be stale with respect to the YAML.
set(REGC_DATA ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/register/src/regc/data)
set(REGC_GEN  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated)

find_program(REGC_EXE regc)
if(NOT REGC_EXE)
    # not installed — run it out of the source tree
    find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
    set(REGC_CMD ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E env
        PYTHONPATH=${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/register/src
        ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} -m regc.cli)
else()
    set(REGC_CMD ${REGC_EXE})
endif()

add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT  ${REGC_GEN}/dbcan_reg_map.h ${REGC_GEN}/dbcan_reg_map.c
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory ${REGC_GEN}
    COMMAND ${REGC_CMD} gen c -o ${REGC_GEN}
    DEPENDS ${REGC_DATA}/global_reg.yaml
            ${REGC_DATA}/register.json
            ${REGC_DATA}/protocol.yaml
    COMMENT "regc: generating register map"
    VERBATIM
)

add_library(dbcan_core STATIC
    ${REGC_GEN}/dbcan_reg_map.c
    core/src/bus_manager.c
)
target_include_directories(dbcan_core PUBLIC ${TRANSPORT_CORE_INC} ${REGC_GEN})

# libsocketcan — vendored submodule, no CMakeLists.txt of its own
add_library(socketcan STATIC libs/libsocketcan/src/libsocketcan.c)
target_include_directories(socketcan PUBLIC libs/libsocketcan/include)
target_include_directories(socketcan PRIVATE libs/libsocketcan/src)
# Suppress the bundled can_netlink.h — use the system <linux/can/netlink.h> instead.
# The bundled copy has guard _CAN_NETLINK_H; the system copy uses _UAPI_CAN_NETLINK_H.
# Pre-defining the bundled guard prevents the duplicate struct definitions.
target_compile_definitions(socketcan PUBLIC _CAN_NETLINK_H)

# SocketCAN transport — Linux only
add_library(dbcan_socketcan STATIC
    transports/src/socketcan_transport.c
)
target_include_directories(dbcan_socketcan PUBLIC
    ${TRANSPORT_CORE_INC}
    ${TRANSPORT_PORT_INC}
    ${REGC_GEN}                 # dbcan_protocol.h — shared enums, via transport.h
)
add_dependencies(dbcan_socketcan dbcan_core)
target_compile_definitions(dbcan_socketcan PUBLIC TRANSPORT_PORT_SOCKETCAN)
target_link_libraries(dbcan_socketcan PUBLIC socketcan)
